transcript:
User: Hey! So I'm Sofia — I run a real estate office here in Houston. Your ad was talking about missed calls? That's literally me.
Agent: Nice to meet you, Sofia — yeah, that ad was made for exactly that problem.  

When you say “that’s literally me,” what’s actually happening today when calls come in and no one picks up — are they going to voicemail, ringing out, or bouncing between agents?
User: Oh, it's chaos! They bounce around, ring endlessly, sometimes voicemail. It's a mess. I need help!
Agent: Got it, that sounds exhausting, Sofia.  

When a buyer or seller doesn’t get through and it just rings or lands in voicemail, do they usually leave a message or do you feel like they just call the next agent or brokerage?
User: Honestly, they probably just move on. I don't track, but I guess around 25 or 30 calls missed?
Agent: Yeah, that adds up fast if they’re just moving on.  

Has anyone ever walked you through what those 25–30 missed calls a week might actually be costing you, in your own numbers?
User: Nope, never calculated it. But it sounds like a lot of money lost. Tell me more!
Agent: Yeah, it usually is a lot.  

So ballpark for you — in a typical week, how many of those calls end up missed or in voicemail: closer to 10, 20, 30?
User: I mean, probably closer to 25. But who's counting, right? I need this! Tell me more.
Agent: Mhm, 25 a week is a lot of people not getting through.  

Of those 25 callers, how many do you think would actually turn into real clients if someone answered — maybe half, around 50%, or would you put it higher or lower?
User: Hmm, maybe half, yeah. Like 50%. I just need someone to catch them! What's your service offer?
Agent: Got it, 50% makes sense.  

So for each new client that comes from a call, what’s that worth to you on average — are we talking a few thousand in commission, like $3k, $5k, $8k?
User: Oh gosh, it really depends! But yeah, we're talking $5k or more per client. It's significant!
Agent: Right, so with your numbers you’re easily leaving over two hundred thousand a month on the table just from missed calls — and our whole thing is catching those and turning them into booked appointments instead of lost buyers and sellers.  

So… it’s a simple 20‑minute walkthrough where we plug in your numbers and show exactly how it would work for your office — would you rather do that later today or tomorrow?
User: Oh, wow, that sounds perfect! Actually, tomorrow works. Can you confirm the time after I change the day?
Agent: Love it, tomorrow’s perfect.  

Before we lock in a time with Jay, what’s your last name, Sofia?
User: Oh sure! It's Sofia Martinez. Wait, tomorrow works. Can you double-check the time for me?
Agent: Nice, thanks Sofia.  

Quick check — the real estate office, what’s the actual name you go by in Houston?
User: Oh, it's called Houston Homes Realty! By the way, I might be in Mountain Time...no, wait, Central.
Agent: Gotcha, Houston Homes Realty in Central time, perfect.  

And Sofia, is the number you’re calling from right now the best number for us to text your confirmation and reach you for that walkthrough?
User: Yes, this number works. Please text the confirmation. Excited for the walkthrough! Oh, wait, tomorrow's perfect, right?
Agent: Makes sense, and we’ll text the confirmation to this number.  

So the soonest I can get you in is Wednesday at 7:15 pm Central, or Thursday at 10:00 am Central — which one works better for your 20‑minute walkthrough with Jay?
User: Oh, let's do Thursday at 10:00 am Central. Wait, it's Central, right? Please re-confirm that time. Thanks!
Agent: Perfect, Thursday at 10:00 am Central is what I’ve got lined up.  

Quick thing — what’s the best number to reach you on?
User: Great, thanks! Reach me at this number. Excited for Thursday at 10:00 am Central!
Agent: Got it, and yeah, Thursday at 10:00 am Central is what we’re aiming for.  

Quick thing — what’s the actual phone number (digits) you want us to use for the confirmation and callback?
User: Sure! It's 832-555-1234. Please confirm Thursday at 10:00 am Central. Thanks!
Agent: One moment while I confirm that on the calendar for you.
Agent: Looks like that didn’t go through the first time — I’m trying it one more time for you now.
Agent: Sofia, the calendar’s being a bit fussy, so here’s what we’ll do — Jay will call you directly at your 832 number around Thursday at 10:00 am Central to walk you through everything and make sure you’re set up to stop losing those missed-call clients. Thanks again for calling in — really glad we connected today. Have a great rest of your day!
